items.t: Won't start with the security light flashing (Passlock)
items.job: Diagnose Passlock fault and replace ignition lock cylinder/sensor
items.note: Some cars only need a security relearn, which costs far less. Owners report an average around $410.

items.t: Cranks but won't start or dies from a failing fuel pump
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump module and fuel filter

items.t: Intake manifold gasket coolant leak
items.job: Replace upper and lower intake manifold gaskets (3.4L V6)
items.note: Add an oil change and coolant refill. If coolant got into the oil, ask about a flush.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifts hard or fails
items.job: Rebuild or replace automatic transaxle
items.note: If a sensor or solenoid is the cause, the repair can be a few hundred dollars instead.

items.t: Turn signals work only sometimes or keep clicking
items.job: Replace turn signal (multifunction) switch
items.note: Basis: YourMechanic estimate (no parts-plus-labor source found): $457–$467 for 1999–2004 Alero; shop/dealer $533–$771.

items.t: Turn signals can stop working from the hazard switch (recall)
items.job: Replace hazard warning switch (recall)

items.t: Horn blows by itself
items.job: Replace horn contacts or steering wheel horn/airbag pad
items.note: A used airbag pad is cheaper; dealers quoted about $700-800 for a new one.

items.t: Dashboard cover wrinkles, shrinks or peels
items.job: Replace dashboard top cover
items.note: A molded dash cap that fits over the old one costs a fraction of this.

items.t: Power window falls into the door or stops working
items.job: Replace window regulator (with motor), one door

items.t: Key won't turn or sticks in the ignition
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder and relearn Passlock

items.t: Ignition switch can slip out of Run (recall)
items.job: Ignition switch recall repair

items.t: Blower fan works only on some speeds
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor

items.t: Timing chain rattle or failure
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner (2.2L)
items.note: If the chain already broke, valve damage can push the bill past $2,600 (engine rebuild), based on owner reports for the same engine in the Saturn L-Series.

items.t: Warped front rotors and sticking calipers
items.job: Front brake pads, rotors and one caliper

items.t: Center console lid may open in a crash (recall)
items.job: Console cover repair (recall)

items.t: Steering wheel may come loose (recall)
items.job: Steering wheel inspection and repair (recall)

items.t: Key can come out when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Shift interlock repair (recall)

items.t: Accelerator pedal may not return to idle (recall)
items.job: Accelerator pedal repair (recall)

items.t: Slow coolant leak or water pump leak
items.job: Replace water pump (if the pump is the leak)
items.note: Parts: GM water pump with gasket ($143 sale, $258 MSRP, 3.4L V6). Labor is backed out of RepairPal's 1999 Alero total of $864–$976 (no book time found). A hose or radiator leak costs much less; pressure-test first.

items.t: Engine won't turn over at all
items.job: Test charging system and replace battery (starter if needed)
items.note: Battery replacement is the low end; a starter replacement is the high end.
